items.source: All Condition classes that must match in order for the component to be registered.
items.translation: 所有必须匹配的 Condition 类，以便注册该组件。

items.source: NOTE: Inheritance of @Conditional annotations is not supported; any conditions from superclasses or from overridden methods will not be considered. In order to enforce these semantics, @Conditional itself is not declared as @Inherited; furthermore, any custom composed annotation that is meta-annotated with @Conditional must not be declared as @Inherited.
items.translation: 注意：不支持继承 `@Conditional` 注解；来自父类或重写方法的任何条件都不会被考虑。为了强制执行这些语义，`@Conditional` 本身并未声明为 @Inherited；此外，任何带有 `@Conditional` 元注解的自定义 组合注解 也不应声明为 `@Inherited`。

items.source: If a @Configuration class is marked with @Conditional, all of the @Bean methods, @Import annotations, and @ComponentScan annotations associated with that class will be subject to the conditions.
items.translation: 如果 `@Configuration` 类被标记了 `@Conditional`，那么与该关联的该类的所有 `@Bean` 方法、@Import 注解和 @ComponentScan 注解都将受条件约束。

items.source: A condition is any state that can be determined programmatically before the bean definition is due to be registered (see Condition for details).
items.translation: 条件 是指可以在注册 Bean 定义之前通过编程方式确定的任何状态（有关详细信息，请参阅Condition）。

items.source: The @Conditional annotation may be used in any of the following ways:
items.translation: @Conditional 注解可以以以下任意方式使用：

items.source: as a type-level annotation on any class directly or indirectly annotated with @Component, including @Configuration classes
items.translation: 作为任何直接或间接标注了 `@Component` 的类（包括 `@Configuration` 类）的类型级注解。

items.source: as a method-level annotation on any @Bean method
items.translation: 作为任何 `@Bean` 方法的**方法级注解**。

items.source:
as a meta-annotation, for the purpose of composing custom stereotype
annotations
items.translation: 作为元注解，用于组合自定义的立体注解。
